title: Chicken teriyaki with vegetables
summary: Chicken teriyaki with vegetables is a japanese dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and broccoli, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat skinless chicken thigh fillets dry and season it. Prep broccoli and carrots for Chicken teriyaki with vegetables so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook skinless chicken thigh fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook broccoli and carrots in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken teriyaki with vegetables before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice skinless chicken thigh fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
